name: Partisan
body:
Price +1 bonus; Slot none; CL 8th; Weight —; Aura moderate evocation

DESCRIPTION

A partisan weapon is devoted to the cause of a single nation or city-state, infused with the unified power of the citizenry and their devotion to their homeland. If the wielder is a citizen of the attuned nation, city, or state, she gains several benefits. First, the wielder gains a +4 insight bonus on Bluff, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand checks to conceal the weapon from citizens of other nations. On a successful hit against a flat-footed humanoid target of a different nationality, the target must succeed at DC 13 Will save or be shaken for 1 minute. Finally, the wielder receives a +2 bonus to confirm critical hits against humanoid citizens of other nations.

The creator of a partisan weapon must be a citizen of the nation to be attuned to the weapon. This nation must be determined at the weapon’s creation and cannot be altered.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +1 bonus; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells weapon of awe, creator must be a citizen of the chosen nation
